contract.intent: Resolve contract-owned files, SSOT paths, and helper imports to exact repository-relative source files before querying or writing the sharded index.

must_not_change: Source-root-relative aliases must be resolved from configured source roots, not guessed from path suffixes.
File lookup candidates must keep exact physical paths and extension variants only.
Package imports must not be written as by-file index keys.

contract.intent: Format stable Drift diagnostics so CLI, ESLint, CI, and agents receive consistent error codes, locations, and severity prefixes.

must_not_change: DRIFTxxx codes must remain stable and human-readable.
Diagnostic severity formatting must preserve info, warning, and error levels.
Error locations must include file and line when available.
